ja: この関数、もっと小さいヘルパー関数に分けることを検討してもらえますか？
en: Could you consider splitting this function into smaller helper functions?
alternatives: Would you consider breaking this function up into smaller helpers?
Could you think about splitting this function into smaller helper functions?
point: consider の後ろは to 不定詞ではなく動名詞

ja: 田中さんにこの PR をレビューしてくれるよう頼んでもらえますか？
en: Could you ask Tanaka-san to review this PR?
alternatives: Can you ask Tanaka-san to review this PR?
Could you ask Tanaka to take a look at this PR?
point: 「人に〜するよう頼む」は ask + 人 + to do

ja: PR の説明に、パフォーマンスへの影響についての情報を少し追加してもらえますか？
en: Could you add some information about the performance impact to the PR description?
alternatives: Can you add a bit of information about the performance impact to the PR description?
Could you add some details about the performance impact to the PR description?
point: information は数えられないので an も -s もつけない

ja: 先月このエッジケースのテストを追加していれば、僕たちは今ごろ本番でこのバグを追いかけていなかったはずです。
en: If we'd added a test for this edge case last month, we wouldn't be chasing this bug in production now.
alternatives: If we had added a test for this edge case last month, we wouldn't be tracking down this bug in production now.
If we'd written a test for this edge case last month, we wouldn't be chasing this bug in production right now.
point: 過去の仮定は had added、今の結果は wouldn't be -ing

ja: 指摘されたところは、もう全部直しました。
en: I've already fixed all the issues you pointed out.
alternatives: I've already fixed everything you pointed out.
I've already addressed all of your comments.
point: 「もう直した」は現在完了 I've already fixed

ja: 指摘ありがとうございます。僕が気にしていたのは、リトライ処理がエラーを隠してしまわないかということです。
en: Thanks for pointing that out. What I was worried about was whether the retry logic would hide errors.
alternatives: Thanks for the feedback. My concern was that the retry logic might hide errors.
Thanks for the comment. What worried me was whether the retry logic would hide errors.
point: 「気にしていたこと」は What I was worried about で主語に

ja: この PR で追加されたテスト、本物の API を呼んでいるので、モックに置き換えたほうがいいと思います。
en: The tests added in this PR call the real API, so I think they should use mocks instead.
alternatives: The tests added in this PR are hitting the real API, so they should probably use mocks.
The tests added in this PR call the actual API, so I think we should mock it instead.
point: 「追加されたテスト」は過去分詞で後ろから修飾

ja: このレビューで特に見てほしいのは、ネットワークが切れたときにリトライ処理がちゃんと動くかどうかです。
en: What I'd especially like you to check is whether the retry logic still works when the network drops.
alternatives: What I'd really like you to look at is whether the retry logic works properly if the network drops.
The thing I'd especially like you to check is whether the retry logic still works when the connection drops.
point: 「見てほしいのは」は What I'd like you to check is で始める

ja: テスト、昨日は通ってたんだけど、今朝リベースしてからずっと3件落ちてるんだ。
en: The tests passed yesterday, but since I rebased this morning, three of them have been failing.
alternatives: The tests were passing yesterday, but three of them have been failing since I rebased this morning.
Yesterday the tests passed, but ever since I rebased this morning, three have been failing.
point: 昨日は過去形、今朝から続く状態は現在完了進行形
